findings.body: The test checks only that the `card_listed` count stays at one and that `CardListedEvent` was not published. An edit or removal that emits a differently named usage event would still pass. Compare the total usage-event count before and after both requests and assert that `publish` was not called.
findings.title: Not done: no usage event for an edit or a removal

findings.body: This branch adds the edit and remove API routes, but the edit reminder, placement of field and form errors, and removal confirmation with a working Cancel action still need UI implementation and browser coverage. The supplied assignment places the web tests in T4B, so this is follow-up work for that task.
findings.title: Later: T4B edit screen and browser tests

findings.body: The new `.factory` file records only the branch's working status. It is outside the permitted paths and is not needed to deliver card editing or removal.
findings.title: Remove the out-of-scope task-state file
